_what: Q178 critical-path budget, checked by `node scripts/perf/critical-path.mjs --check` against the BUILT bundle (bundle-size.yml, npm run gate). Rounds are exact both ways; KB is a band (+5% fails as a regression, -10% fails as a stale budget). Lower these in the same commit as the change that lowers them.
